lines.text: The root is Mit! Commit, transmit, emit.
Did you know? Mit is Latin for send.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus send?

words.ex: She is committed to helping the local community.
The virus is transmitted through contaminated water.
Older cars emit more harmful gases than newer models.
